ruleDefinitions.name: Add Insecure Download Source To Winget
ruleDefinitions.description:
Detects usage of winget to add a new insecure (http) download source.
Winget will not allow the addition of insecure sources, hence this could indicate potential suspicious activity (or typos)

sequences.query: ((process_path = RGX("\\\\winget\\\.exe$") OR process_original_file_name = "winget\.exe") AND (process_command_line = RGX(".*source\\ .*") AND process_command_line = RGX(".*add\\ .*") AND process_command_line = RGX(".*http\\:\\/\\/.*")))
